span.label: mechanisms
span.term: Delay-period activity is sustained because reciprocally connected pyramidal neurons re-excite each other, so discharges keep reverberating around the recurrent circuit after the stimulus is gone.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: Slow postsynaptic receptors (NMDA) keep the postsynaptic cell excited long enough for sparse presynaptic inputs to accumulate, which is what allows low-firing-rate cortical neurons to sustain reverberation.

span.term: Damage to spatial working memory nodes destroys the record of which locations have already been searched, and that failure of book-keeping in the good hemifield compounds the failure to attend to the contralesional one.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: Parietal episodic-memory deficits arise because bottom-up processes no longer capture attention toward internally stored memories, so unprompted recall misses details that a top-down cue can still retrieve.

span.label: RETRACTED (NEITHER ENDPOINT IS ATTESTED AS WRITTEN) · area 7a —part-of→ posterior parietal cortex
span.note: RETRACTED: NEITHER ENDPOINT IS ATTESTED AS WRITTEN. The edge is `area 7a --part-of--> posterior parietal cortex`. The span: 'Quotation withheld and prefrontal areas 46 and FEF.' The paper writes `parietal areas 7a and LIP`; the edge writes `area 7a` and `posterior parietal cortex`. THE CONTAINMENT IS TRUE OF THE FIELD - 7a is a posterior parietal area - AND THE SPAN NEVER SAYS IT, which is the commonest fault in this corpus and one this edge shares with the 66 expanded-endpoint rows measured this hour. Predates the Q-267 endpoint check and would be refused today. Found by the neighbour query (Q-400). Q-423. — strength of the relation: 1

span.label: The proportion of neurons showing working-memory activity is essentially the same in parietal areas 7a and LIP as in prefrontal areas 46 and FEF.
span.note: WHOSE RESULT THIS IS: LIP and prefrontal areas 46 and FEF ( Chafee & Goldman-Rakic, 1998 ). - 2026-08-26 terminal-a. THE RESULT IS THE CITED WORK'S AND THE CITATION TRAILS THE SENTENCE. A plain noun phrase is the subject of the result verb and the attribution is a bracket at the end - `Neurons within the dorsal temporal pole demonstrated match suppression ... ( Ng et al., 2014 )`. Neither of my two cues could see this shape, so THESE WERE READ RATHER THAN SWEPT: 36 candidates of the shape, 20 read, 11 marked, 9 refused. THE REFUSALS ARE WHY IT IS NOT A CUE: `Aru2012 findings[16]` is the paper's OWN result with a citation supporting the localisation, `Natan2015 findings[3]` ends `consistent with previous findings ( Szymanski et al., 2009 )` where the main clause is the paper's, and `Drieu2019` x3 are `One cannot entirely rule out...` - a limitation, not an attribution. About 55% precise, which is a list to read and not a sweep to run. Q-1119.
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Area 7a neurons hold the remembered location of a visual stimulus even when no motor response to it is planned, so the signal is mnemonic rather than motor-preparatory.
span.note: WHOSE RESULT THIS IS: studies in area 7a demonstrated - 2026-08-26 terminal-a. THE SUBJECT OF THIS RESULT IS AN INDEFINITE STUDY, NOT THIS PAPER. `Previous studies reported`, `studies in guinea pig showed`, `recent studies have reported` - somebody else's work under a common noun rather than a name, with a citation in the sentence and no first-person marker. The quote is verbatim and the claim is true; only the attribution is wrong. FOUND BY MEASURING MY OWN CUE'S RECALL: the first sweep required a NAMED author as the subject (`Sperling (1960) demonstrated`) and found 17. Reading eleven citation-bearing findings on `Plakke2016` by hand showed four the cue could not see - `A study examining recognition found`, `studies of typical human subjects have demonstrated`, `A follow up study found` - so the named cue's 17 was a floor and not a count. A CUE'S FALSE POSITIVES TELL YOU NOTHING ABOUT ITS FALSE NEGATIVES, and the only way to find these was to read a record's whole layer. Q-1118.
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.
